title: Kirby Problem 4.107
exact_target: When can a homology-preserving embedding in a symplectization be isotoped to contact type? In standard four-space, ask this for every embedded three-sphere and ask whether a different contact rational homology sphere can occur.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2983 (KP-4.107). CC BY 4.0.
